purpose: Engines that may run beneath the McCluster runtime adapter on owned devices. Each entry is pinned to the exact revision whose LICENSE bytes were fetched and hashed; a different revision is unverified until re-recorded here. The adapter boundary is ours (core/src/compute/*); these engines are separate processes reached over loopback HTTP, never linked into Core.

engines.role: candidate shared-inference runtime for a compatible device group (one model split across two or more owned Macs)
obligations: keep the LICENSE text with any redistribution
mark modified files if the engine is modified
patent license terminates on patent litigation (section 3)
engines.status: license verified; integration not built; no shared-inference claim is made until a real run reports evidence from every participating device

engines.role: single-device inference engine behind core/src/compute/ollama-adapter.mjs (OVH, Windows laptop, Mac)
obligations: keep the copyright and permission notice with any redistribution
engines.status: in use on the OVH node and the Windows pilot; the installed binary version is recorded per node in inventory.runtime.engine_health, not here

engines.role: alternative single-device engine (the backend Ollama builds on); not integrated
obligations: keep the copyright and permission notice with any redistribution

method: git ls-remote <repository> HEAD for the commit; curl of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/<commit>/LICENSE; sha256sum of the exact bytes; SPDX read from the text. Re-run the same three commands to re-verify; a changed hash means a changed license.
